description: This file defines the ListActions class, which manages a list of scheduled actions in the blivet-gui application, including adding, removing, and clearing actions, and updating the GUI accordingly.

classes.name: ListActions
classes.description: Manages a list of scheduled actions in the blivet-gui, including GUI updates and action management.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes ListActions with references to GUI components and loads action icons.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the actions list and updates GUI to show no pending actions.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new action to the list and updates the GUI accordingly.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes the last action from the list and updates the GUI.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all actions from the list and resets GUI indicators.
